lines.text: One, two
One, two, three
Like water in the desert
Impossible to find
But you found me when I was broken
lines.translation: Tapi kamu menemukanku ketika aku sedang hancur

lines.text: Put me back together, gave me life
lines.translation: Satukan aku kembali, beri aku kehidupan

lines.text: Like a flower in the concrete

You gave me hope when I was empty
lines.translation: Anda memberi saya harapan ketika saya kosong

lines.text: Walked me through the fire, you were there
lines.translation: Menemaniku melewati api, kamu ada di sana

lines.text: You're the sun to the moon
